settings.heading: SP-105 vs. comparable entry tri bikes
settings.note: We're a younger brand, so it's fair to ask how we stack up. Here's a straight comparison against the entry 105 builds from two established names — prices are current MSRP for the closest equivalent build. Where they beat us, we say so.

settings.title: Frame & fork
settings.rows:
Material | Hand-laid Toray T700 carbon fiber
Frame weight | 1,250 g (size M, painted)
Tube profiles | Truncated-airfoil (kammtail) down tube, seat tube & fork
Routing | Fully internal cable & hydraulic hose
Designer | Kevin Quan (former Cervélo P-Series engineer)

settings.title: Drivetrain
settings.rows:
Groupset | Shimano 105 R7100, 12-speed mechanical
Shifting | Bar-end shifters (TT/tri standard)
Crankset | 52/36T mid-compact
Cassette | 11–34T, 12-speed
Brakes | Shimano 105 hydraulic disc, flat-mount

settings.title: Wheels & tires
settings.rows:
Wheelset | Vision Team 30 alloy, tubeless-ready
Tires | Continental Ultra Sport III, 700×28c
Axles | 12mm thru-axle, front & rear
Upgrade path | Accepts standard 12-speed wheelsets — many owners add deep aero wheels for race day

settings.title: Cockpit & fit (SAGS)
settings.rows:
Aerobar | SAGS integrated cockpit, alloy extensions
Pad adjustment | 140mm fore/aft, 95mm stack range
Extension shape | Ski-bend, tool-free angle adjust
Base bar | Aero alloy, internally routed

settings.title: Geometry & sizing
settings.rows:
Sizes | XS · S · M · L · XL
Rider range | ~5'1" to 6'4" (155–193 cm)
Size M fits | ~5'7"–5'10"
Sizing help | Free remote fit call + size calculator; free exchanges

settings.title: In the box & assembly
settings.rows:
Pre-assembly | Ships 92% assembled
You install | Seatpost, cockpit, and brake dial-in — the headset & stem are the fiddly parts, so take your time with the included torque wrench
Typical setup time | Under an hour with the included video guide
Prefer a shop? | Most local shops finish the build for $50–150
